# Oak Fantasy

> Workshop in western Romania handcrafting solid-wood cutting boards —
> Romanian oak, and oak with ash on some models. What is in the catalog is
> in stock: orders are made in 5–10 business days from confirmation and
> delivered by courier. Romanian-first site (RO default, EN available).
> The store is open and selling.

Oak Fantasy is a family business with its own workshop, not a factory.
Tagline: „Făcut cu drag în România." ("From Romanian oak, by hand.")

## Facts worth citing

- Wood: Romanian oak, chosen piece by piece for its grain; some models
  combine oak and ash. The wood is dried until it is stable before any
  board is made.
- Assembly: precise cuts, **food-safe adhesive**, 24-hour clamping under
  uniform pressure.
- Designs (bull, fish, stag, lovers) are **CNC-carved** in the workshop;
  on the boards the outline is painted in food-safe paint. Cutting,
  gluing, sanding and oiling we do ourselves, in the same workshop.
- Sanding: four to five grits, **from 80 to 320** — no rush, no pressure.
- Finish: **food-safe oil**, layer after layer.
- Lead time: orders are made in **5–10 business days** from confirmation.
- Shipping: **Romania only**, by courier (25 RON flat, free from 500 RON);
  usually 1–3 business days in transit once shipped.
- Payment: **cash on delivery only** (paid to the courier). No card or
  other online payments for now.
- Returns: standard products can be returned within **14 days** of
  delivery, no reason needed (the customer pays return shipping).
  Engraved products and custom work cannot be returned (made to the
  customer's specifications). Damaged, faulty or wrong products are
  remade, replaced or refunded at our cost, engraved ones included.
- Custom work: request through the custom orders form, then details and
  price are agreed on WhatsApp. Engraving (names, dates, drawings, logos)
  is done in the workshop and available on some models.
- Catalog: cutting boards, serving boards and other pieces in solid wood;
  the catalog page lists the current models, prices and dimensions.
- Every board is unique — its own grain. Boards are designed to be
  inherited, not thrown away.
